note: 생활 장면표(계획 Task 4, 2026-11-19) — 그 도시 사람들이 실제로 보내는 하루의 장면을 세 세계로 옮긴다(설계 3-1절). 장면은 그 도시에 실제로 있는 생활 모습만, 근거 src(위키백과). 장면 한 줄: key · ko · src · base(받침 · 장소 종류 · 자세 추천을 빌리는 일상컷 트리 장소 — data/casual-tree*.json) · indoor(날씨 줄 없음) · times · seasons(되는 시간대 · 계절 — 없으면 다) · outfits(이 장면에서 계획기가 고르는 의상 계열) · en(세계를 타지 않은 장면 이름 — 트리 장소 글, 지시문에는 안 나온다) · worlds.<세계>.en(같은 일상이 그 세계의 시대로 옮겨진 모습 — 일상컷 Place 줄) · props(소품 열쇠 — data/world-props.json, Around her 줄). 조립기(lib/prompt-city.js lifeTree)가 장면마다 트리 장소 <도시>_<장면> 을 만든다(받침은 base 것, 땅 = 도시). times 는 모든 도시가 같이, seasons · weather 는 도시마다(그 도시에 맞는 것만, 근거). 판타지 · 스팀펑크 글에는 그 세계 banned_en(data/city-design.json) 낱말이 없다(tests/prompt-city.cjs).

times.en: dawn — the first pale light before the city wakes, the last lamps still lit and the streets quiet
the morning rush hour — low clean sunlight and the city's crowd hurrying to work
the evening rush after work — the warm low sun sinking into dusk and lamps coming on along the street
evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky
past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty

seoul.en: spring — cherry blossoms in bloom and petals drifting on the air
the jangma rainy season of early summer — heavy, humid air under low grey skies
high summer — hot, humid air and strong sunlight
autumn — cool, clear, dry air and turning leaves
winter — cold, dry, frosty air, breath showing in the cold

tokyo.en: spring — cherry blossoms in full bloom and petals drifting on the air
the tsuyu rainy season of early summer — humid air and soft, steady rain under low grey skies
high summer — hot, humid air and strong sunlight
autumn — clear, mild air and ginkgo trees turning bright golden yellow
winter — cool, dry, clear air under bright pale skies

newyork.en: spring — mild air, fresh green leaves and flowering trees in the parks
high summer — hot, humid air and strong sunlight
autumn — crisp, clear air and park trees turning red, orange and gold
winter — cold air, bare trees and old snow along the curbs

rome.en: spring — mild air, fresh green leaves and flowers spilling from the balconies
high summer — hot, dry air under a fierce, cloudless sun
autumn — mild golden days between the year's heaviest rains
winter — mild, cool days and damp air, bare trees beside the evergreen pines

paris.en: spring — mild days and cool nights, fresh green leaves on the avenue trees and flowers in the gardens
summer — warm, sunny days, now and then a spell of intense heat
autumn — mild, changeable days and cool nights, the avenue trees turning gold
winter — cold, grey days just above freezing, bare trees and a light frost in the morning

london.en: spring — mild days and fresh green leaves in the parks and garden squares
summer — warm, sometimes hot days and everyone out on the grass in the parks
autumn — cooler, changeable days and the park trees turning gold
winter — cool, grey days under frequent cloud and bare trees in the garden squares

beijing.en: spring — dry, quickly warming days, fresh green leaves on the willows and now and then a dusty wind from the far deserts
summer — hot, humid monsoon days, heavy air and sudden rain
autumn — a short, dry and clear season, crisp blue skies and the trees turning gold
winter — brief but cold, dry days under clear pale skies, the lakes frozen and the willows bare

istanbul.en: spring — mild days slowly warming after a chilly March, fresh green leaves on the hillsides along the strait
summer — warm to hot, mostly sunny and fairly dry days, a breeze off the water
autumn — mild, still-warm days slowly turning cooler, cloudier and wetter
winter — cool, cloudy and frequently rainy days, now and then snow

cairo.en: spring — warm, quickly heating days under a pale sky, and now and then a hot, dusty wind blowing in from the desert
summer — long, hot and dry days of strong sun and hard shadows, the evenings warm and close by the river
autumn — still-warm, sunny days slowly turning milder, the evenings by the river growing pleasant
winter — mild, mostly sunny days and cool nights, now and then a brief shower

rio.en: summer — December to March, hot, humid and stormy days, the heat broken by long spells of heavy rain
carnival days — the hot late-summer days before Lent, when the whole city fills with drums, brass bands, dancing crowds and costumes
autumn — still-warm days after the summer rains, the air growing a little less heavy
winter — June to August, warm, sunny and drier days, the mornings cooled by sea breezes and passing cold fronts
spring — warm days slowly growing hotter and more humid toward summer

busan.en: spring — mild sea air and cherry blossoms along the river
early summer — warm days kept cooler than inland by the sea breeze
high summer, the beach season — hot, humid air and crowded beaches
late summer, the typhoon season — hot, humid and rainy, with storms sweeping in from the sea
autumn, the festival season — clear skies and pleasant, comfortable air
winter — cool, dry and windy, milder than the rest of the country

bangkok.en: the hot season — March to mid-May, fierce sun and heavy, sticky heat, April the hottest month of the year
Songkran days — the Thai New Year in mid-April, at the height of the heat, when the whole city takes to the streets to splash each other with water
the rainy season — mid-May to October, the southwest monsoon bringing heavy afternoon downpours, September the wettest month
the cool season — November to February, the dry northeast monsoon bringing clearer skies, a fresher breeze and the mildest mornings of the year, the days still warm

barcelona.en: spring — March to late May, mild and changeable days, sometimes a sea fog rolling in off the still-cool water
summer — late May to late September, warm to hot days, long hours of sunshine and a sea breeze along the shore
autumn — October to December, the rainiest season, mild days broken by long spells of rain
winter — mild, short days with cool mornings, now and then a cold north wind sweeping down to the sea

sydney.en: summer — December to February, warm to hot days by the water, the beaches crowded and the evenings long and bright
autumn — March to May, settled, mild days turning cooler and crisper from mid-April
winter — June to August, mild, cool and mostly sunny days with chilly mornings by the sea
spring — September to November, warming days with sudden swings of weather and the jacaranda trees blooming violet

mexicocity.en: the cool dry season — November to February, crisp sunny days and chilly mornings under a clear, dry highland sky
the warm dry spring — March to May, bright warm days before the rains, the air still dry
jacaranda time in March — the city's jacaranda trees in full violet bloom, purple blossoms carpeting the pavements
the rainy summer — May to October, mild green days and heavy rains, the wettest in July

daejeon.en: spring — mild days and cherry blossoms in bloom along the lakeside roads
the monsoon season of high summer — the heaviest rain of the year, warm and wet
high summer — hot and humid, a little milder than the other big cities
autumn — clear skies with the least cloud of the year and the first frost early in the season
winter — cold and dry, with a north-west wind
